bibl.title: Private and Commercial Pigeon Breeding Taxed. Ptolemaic Levies on Pigeon Houses and their Revenues.
bibl.seg: Katelijn Vandorpe & Lisa Vanoppré, Private and Commercial Pigeon Breeding Taxed. Ptolemaic Levies on Pigeon Houses and their Revenues.
bibl.note: From delicacy to manure provision: the pigeon's many uses. - Location, construction and size of pigeon houses in Ptolemaic Egypt. - Taxing the revenues: the one-third tax on pigeon houses (app. 1-2). - Taxing the property: the cubit tax on pigeon houses (app. 3). - Target group(s) of pigeon house taxes. - Appendix 1: Tax receipts for the one-third tax on the pigeon houses; - Appendix 2: Other types of texts mentioning the one-third tax on the pigeon houses; - Appendix 3: Receipts for the cubit tax on pigeon houses.
